title: apartment garden
content: I keep dreaming about a small run down apartment complex of like 10 units. There is a courtyard balcony thing in the middle of the units with a community garden, there’s pumpkins and peppers and some other veggies growing there. The whole complex is next to the ocean. Sometimes people are hanging out on benches in the garden reading and smoking. Has anyone else been here? It’s weirdly calm on comparison to what is normally going on in my mallworld dreams.
